misprints.note: The print has two full stops.
There is no full stop after the s.
The iota is missing from the ending.
The feminine ending is printed without breathing or accent.
Printed with a rough breathing; earlier in the same entry it has a smooth one.
The prefix is not assimilated (the usual spelling is ἐγγίγνεται).

uncertain.note: The mark over the ω of the genitive ending is small. I read it as a circumflex without breathing; the OCR had ὤνος.
The stop after ταῦτα is faint.
